# shastra

> Vedic astrology computed deterministically with the Swiss Ephemeris and explained in plain
> language. Free daily reading over WhatsApp; two flat-priced one-time reports. No per-minute
> consultation, no subscription, and no remedies, gemstones or pujas sold anywhere.

shastra is run by Adhokshaj Wategaonkar, a sole proprietor in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
(Udyam registration UDYAM-KR-03-0737428).

## The one architectural fact worth knowing

Chart mathematics and interpretation are separated in software, not just in principle. Every
planetary position, nakshatra, vimshottari dasha date and guna milan point is computed in code with
the Swiss Ephemeris. A language model (Claude Haiku) receives the computed chart as structured data
and writes the interpretation. The model never calculates a position, and never receives a birth
date, birth place, email address or phone number.

## Conventions used

- Zodiac: sidereal
- Ayanamsa: Lahiri (Chitrapaksha), defined by Spica at exactly 180°00′ sidereal longitude
- House system: whole sign
- Lunar node: mean
- Ephemeris: Swiss Ephemeris in Moshier mode, accuracy ≈ 0.1 arcseconds
- Vimshottari year: 365.25 days

The engine's test suite asserts the ayanamsa against its own definition (Spica at 180°00′), the
ayanamsa value at the 1956 ICRC epoch, two NASA eclipse times as ayanamsa-independent checks, and
three published reference charts.

## Pricing

- Daily reading over WhatsApp — free, permanently
- Kundli, guna milan score, sade sati dates — free, no account
- Career reading — ₹99, one-time
- Compatibility reading — ₹149, one-time

There is no subscription and nothing auto-renews. Refunds are given within 7 days on request with
no reason required.

## Why the daily reading can be free

In India a business-initiated WhatsApp template message costs the sender roughly ₹1.09, which is
about ₹33 per user per month for a daily send. A reply inside a conversation the user started costs
nothing. So the user messages first each morning and the reading returns as a free service reply.
shastra never sends a proactive daily message; the economics of the product depend on that.

## Editorial rules, enforced in code

No predictions about death, illness, pregnancy or accidents. No medical, legal or financial
directives. No fear-selling, no manufactured urgency, no promised outcomes. No remedies of any
kind. At most two mentions of a paid report per user per week, and only when a real upcoming
transit justifies it. These rules are embedded in every generation prompt and asserted by tests; a
prompt that ships without them fails the build.

## Pages

- [Home](https://adhokshajwategaonkar.github.io/shastra-site/): what shastra is, how the morning ritual works, full pricing, the ethics rules
- [Free kundli](https://adhokshajwategaonkar.github.io/shastra-site/kundli/): birth chart generator — lagna, nine grahas with nakshatra and pada, navamsa, vimshottari dasha, panchanga. Explains what a kundli is, what Lahiri ayanamsa is, what a nakshatra is, and why vedic and western sun signs differ
- [Kundli matching](https://adhokshajwategaonkar.github.io/shastra-site/kundli-matching/): 36-point ashtakoota guna milan calculator with a per-koota breakdown. Explains how guna milan is scored, what the 18/25 thresholds mean and do not mean, nadi dosha, and mangal dosha
- [Sade sati](https://adhokshajwategaonkar.github.io/shastra-site/sade-sati/): sade sati calculator returning exact Saturn ingress dates including retrograde re-entries, plus dhaiya. Explains what sade sati is, its three phases, and why its length varies
